title: Helicopter chases of about 15 UAP in 60 days; never seen from the air

tellings.quote: Then we sit down in helicopter and we're chasing behind them. I probably pursued about 15 NAYA per the last 60 days.

plain: James Valor, of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, says that in 2025 he chased about 15 unidentified objects by helicopter over roughly 60 days. He tells it as his own fieldwork: once something appears, the team gets into the helicopter and pursues it. It is offered as a sign that the objects can be called up and followed on purpose.
